description: Blue Magic Pools specializes in pool leaks in Miami. Tell us what you have noticed and ask about the next step for your pool.

services.title: Find the leak.
services.label: Leak detection
services.description: Losing water without an obvious explanation? Talk with a pool-leak specialist about what you are seeing and the inspection your pool may need.

services.title: Address the problem.
services.label: Pool leak repair
services.description: Already know there is a leak? Discuss the location, previous findings, and the repair options for your particular pool.

services.title: Look a little closer.
services.label: Skimmer leak issues
services.description: Water loss near the skimmer deserves a closer look. Ask Blue Magic Pools about inspection and repair options before deciding what needs replacing.
